notes.title: 🧟 Major Update: AI Overhaul, Performance Boost & More! 🏚️
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

We’re thrilled to roll out a major update for Mansion of the Dead! Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping the game, and this patch brings significant improvements to gameplay, performance, and overall experience. Here's what's new:

🔧 Key Updates
🧠 Smarter, Deadlier Zombies

We’ve improved the zombie AI and animations, making them more reactive, unpredictable, and terrifying than ever. Stay alert—they're watching your every move.

🚀 Optimized Rendering Pipeline

Enjoy smoother gameplay with a fully optimized rendering pipeline, boosting frame rates and reducing visual stutter across most systems.

🎮 Adjusted Difficulty Balancing

We've fine-tuned difficulty settings to offer a more balanced yet challenging experience—whether you're a first-time explorer or a seasoned investigator.

🏃‍♂️ Player Movement Enhancements

Movement has been refined and optimized for tighter control and better responsiveness during intense escape sequences.

🖥️ UI Improvements

The user interface has been polished with cleaner layouts, better feedback, and improved readability to keep you immersed in the horror.

🌍 Better Localization

We’ve improved localization across supported languages for a more immersive and understandable experience no matter where you’re playing from.

notes.title: fixed a bug on the pistol
notes.content: Fixed a bug on the pistol. Now it will no longer be unable to shoot in certain situations.

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustment
notes.content: Fixed some bugs and adjusted the difficulty. Adjusted zombie's AI.
